```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
 fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3.3, dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("."))
find_dataset <- function(names, subdir = "Supplementary_Datasets", max_up = 6) {
 if (is.character(names) && length(names) == 1) names <- c(names)
 prefix <- "."
 for (i in 0:max_up) {
 for (nm in names) { rel <- file.path(prefix, subdir, nm); if (file.exists(rel)) return(rel) }
 prefix <- file.path(prefix, "..")
 }
 stop("Dataset not found under a 'Supplementary_Datasets/' folder: ", paste(names, collapse = " / "))
}
```

# Overview

Supplement panel **Figure S5B** (= R4-3 cross-modal "Midsagittal · ≤2 wk of MRI"). MRI 3D segmented cerebellar
volume vs the midsagittal ultrasound 2D size composite (inverse-correlation-weighted z-score), restricted to
ultrasound scans within 2 weeks of the MRI (well-matched). Pearson r. Coloured by GA group (EP/VP/LP).

```{r data}
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

ga_cols <- c(EP = "#030403", VP = "#DE1567", LP = "#7BACDC")
zc <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
wcomp <- function(df, cols) {
 Z <- sapply(cols, function(c) zc(df[[c]]))
 cm <- cor(Z[complete.cases(Z), , drop = FALSE])
 w <- 1 - sapply(seq_along(cols), function(i) mean(abs(cm[i, -i]))); w <- w / sum(w)
 as.numeric(Z %*% w)
}
gl <- function(g) factor(toupper(trimws(as.character(g))), levels = names(ga_cols))

data_file <- find_dataset(c("Dataset_Clinical_MRI_US_ND.xlsx", "Dataset_S1_Clinical_MRI_US_ND.xlsx"))
us <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = "Ultrasound") %>% mutate(Study_ID = as.character(Study_ID))
mri <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = "MRI") %>% filter(Included == "Yes") %>%
 mutate(Study_ID = as.character(Study_ID)) %>%
 select(Study_ID, GA_Group, MRI_PMA_weeks, Cerebellar_Volume_mm3)

# ultrasound scan nearest the MRI per subject; composites on that set; then keep <=2 wk
us_tea <- us %>% inner_join(mri %>% select(Study_ID, MRI_PMA_weeks), by = "Study_ID") %>%
 mutate(gap_wk = abs(PMA_weeks - MRI_PMA_weeks)) %>%
 group_by(Study_ID) %>% slice_min(gap_wk, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
us_tea$US_Coronal_Comp <- wcomp(us_tea, c("Coronal_Height", "Coronal_Transverse", "Coronal_Area"))
us_tea$US_Midsag_Comp <- wcomp(us_tea, c("Midsag_AP", "Midsag_Height", "Midsag_Area"))
d <- us_tea %>% select(Study_ID, US_Coronal_Comp, US_Midsag_Comp, gap_wk) %>%
 inner_join(mri, by = "Study_ID") %>% mutate(GA = gl(GA_Group))
dm <- d %>% filter(gap_wk <= 2) # well-matched (n = 34)
```

```{r figure-s3c, fig.width=3, fig.height=3.3}
xv <- "US_Midsag_Comp"; yv <- "Cerebellar_Volume_mm3"
ok <- complete.cases(dm[[xv]], dm[[yv]]); dd <- dm[ok, ]
ct <- cor.test(dd[[xv]], dd[[yv]])
lab <- sprintf("italic(r) == %.2f * ',' ~~ italic(P) %s", ct$estimate,
 ifelse(ct$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("== ", sprintf('%.3f', ct$p.value))))

p <- ggplot(dd, aes(.data[[xv]], .data[[yv]])) +
 geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = "gray80", aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.4) +
 geom_point(aes(colour = GA), alpha = 1, size = 1.8) +
 annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab, parse = TRUE, hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.7, size = 3) +
 scale_colour_manual(values = ga_cols, name = NULL) +
 scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
 labs(x = "Midsagittal composite (Z-score)", y = expression("Cerebellar volume (mm"^3*")")) +
 theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
 theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank(),
 axis.line = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
 axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
 legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
 plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 3, 3))
p
ggsave("Figure_S5B_Vol_vs_MidsagComposite.pdf", p, width = 3, height = 3.3, dpi = 300)
message("n (<=2wk) = ", nrow(dd), "; r = ", round(ct$estimate,2), "; P = ", signif(ct$p.value,3))
```
